lessons.title: Tiền tệ và giao dịch ngân hàng cơ bản
lessons.objective: Nói số tiền, đổi tiền, gửi và rút tiền tại ngân hàng.
lessons.reading:
Customer: Good morning. I'd like to change some US dollars into Vietnamese dong.
Teller: Certainly. How much would you like to change?
Customer: Two hundred dollars.
Teller: The exchange rate today is 25,400 dong to the dollar. Can I see your passport?
Customer: Here you are. Can I also withdraw some money from my account?
Teller: Of course. Please fill in this form.

vocabulary.example: I'd like to change some money.
I want to withdraw some money.
I'd like to deposit this cheque.
I have an account at this bank.

grammar.title: How much / How many
grammar.explanation: How much + danh từ không đếm được (How much money?). How many + danh từ đếm được số nhiều (How many dollars?). Tiền tệ: 200 dollars, 5 million dong.
examples: How much money do you need?
How many notes do you want?
I'd like to withdraw five million dong.

pronunciation.tip: 25,400 = twenty-five thousand four hundred. $200 = two hundred dollars. Không thêm 's' vào hundred/thousand khi có số đứng trước.

speakingTasks: Đóng vai khách hàng đổi tiền và rút tiền với thầy/cô.
Đọc to 5 số tiền khác nhau bằng tiếng Anh.

questions.prompt: What currency does the customer change?
questions.explanation: 'change some US dollars'.

questions.prompt: How much does the customer change?
questions.explanation: 'Two hundred dollars.'

questions.prompt: What does the teller ask to see?
questions.explanation: 'Can I see your passport?'
money không đếm được → How much.
withdraw = rút tiền ra.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I want to _____ some money.
questions.explanation: “withdraw” nghĩa là “rút (tiền)”. Câu đầy đủ: I want to withdraw some money.
“withdraw” = rút (tiền). Ví dụ: I want to withdraw some money.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I have an _____ at this bank.
questions.explanation: “account” nghĩa là “tài khoản”. Câu đầy đủ: I have an account at this bank.
“exchange rate” = tỷ giá. Ví dụ: What's the exchange rate today?

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: What's the _____ today?
questions.explanation: “exchange rate” nghĩa là “tỷ giá”. Câu đầy đủ: What's the exchange rate today?

lessons.title: Mở tài khoản ngân hàng
lessons.objective: Hỏi và trả lời thông tin khi mở tài khoản, các loại thẻ và phí.
lessons.reading:
Customer: Hi, I'd like to open a savings account.
Officer: Sure. Do you have any ID with you?
Customer: Yes, my ID card.
Officer: Great. Would you like a debit card too?
Customer: Yes, please. Is there a monthly fee?
Officer: No, there isn't, but you need to keep at least one million dong in the account.
Customer: Can I use online banking?
Officer: Yes, you can. I'll help you set it up.

vocabulary.example: I'd like to open an account.
Would you like a debit card?
I use online banking every day.

grammar.title: would like / I'd like
grammar.explanation: I'd like + danh từ / to + V: lịch sự hơn I want. Câu hỏi: Would you like…? Trả lời: Yes, please. / No, thank you.
examples: I'd like to open an account.
Would you like a credit card?
I'd like some information, please.

pronunciation.tip: card /kɑːd/ (Anh) — miệng mở rộng, âm dài. fee /fiː/ — âm 'i' dài, không đọc thành 'phi' ngắn.

speakingTasks: Mở một tài khoản ngân hàng với thầy/cô: hỏi phí, thẻ và ngân hàng điện tử.
Hỏi về lãi suất tiết kiệm.

questions.prompt: What kind of account does the customer open?
questions.explanation: 'a savings account'.
'No, there isn't'.
'at least one million dong'.

options: I'd like to open an account.
questions.explanation: I'd like to + V.

questions.prompt: Which card does the officer offer?
questions.explanation: 'Would you like a debit card too?'

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Would you like a _____?
questions.explanation: “debit card” nghĩa là “thẻ ghi nợ”. Câu đầy đủ: Would you like a debit card?
“online banking” = ngân hàng trực tuyến. Ví dụ: I use online banking every day.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Is there a _____?
questions.explanation: “monthly fee” nghĩa là “phí hàng tháng”. Câu đầy đủ: Is there a monthly fee?
“monthly fee” = phí hàng tháng. Ví dụ: Is there a monthly fee?

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Please show your _____.
questions.explanation: “ID card” nghĩa là “chứng minh/căn cước”. Câu đầy đủ: Please show your ID card.

lessons.title: Hóa đơn và thanh toán
lessons.objective: Đọc hóa đơn, hỏi số tiền phải trả, hạn thanh toán và phương thức thanh toán.
lessons.reading:
Invoice no. 1024
Customer: Green Café
Item: 50 kg of coffee beans — $600
Delivery: $40
Total: $640
Payment due: 30 April
Payment methods: bank transfer or credit card
Please include the invoice number in your payment.

vocabulary.example: Can I pay by credit card?

grammar.title: Giới từ: pay by / pay in / due on
grammar.explanation: pay by card/transfer/cheque; pay in cash; due on + ngày (due on 30 April); due by + hạn chót.
examples: Can I pay by card?
He paid in cash.
The payment is due on Friday.

pronunciation.tip: Nhấn âm đầu IN-voice. due /djuː/ (Anh) hoặc /duː/ (Mỹ).

speakingTasks: Đọc to hóa đơn trên và giải thích cho thầy/cô.
Hỏi về hạn và cách thanh toán một hóa đơn.

questions.explanation: 'Payment due: 30 April'.
'Delivery: $40'.
pay in cash.

questions.prompt: What should be included in the payment?
questions.explanation: 'include the invoice number'.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Can I pay by _____?
questions.explanation: “credit card” nghĩa là “thẻ tín dụng”. Câu đầy đủ: Can I pay by credit card?
“invoice” = hóa đơn (bán hàng). Ví dụ: Please check the invoice.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I'll pay by _____.
questions.explanation: “bank transfer” nghĩa là “chuyển khoản ngân hàng”. Câu đầy đủ: I'll pay by bank transfer.
“bank transfer” = chuyển khoản ngân hàng. Ví dụ: I'll pay by bank transfer.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: _____ the invoice number.
questions.explanation: “include” nghĩa là “ghi kèm, bao gồm”. Câu đầy đủ: Include the invoice number.

lessons.title: Tư vấn sản phẩm tiết kiệm và vay
lessons.objective: So sánh các gói tiết kiệm, khoản vay và giải thích lãi suất đơn giản.
lessons.reading:
Customer: I want to save money for two years. What do you recommend?
Advisor: Our fixed-term deposit pays 5.5% a year. The flexible savings account pays less — 3% — but you can take your money out at any time.
Customer: What happens if I withdraw early from the fixed-term account?
Advisor: You'll lose some of the interest.
Customer: I see. I think the fixed-term one is better for me because I won't need the money.

vocabulary.example: A flexible account lets you withdraw anytime.
If you withdraw early, you lose interest.
I'd like to apply for a loan.

grammar.title: So sánh: more/less + adj, better, the best
grammar.explanation: Dùng so sánh hơn để tư vấn: higher interest, more flexible, less risky. Câu kết luận: X is better for you because…
examples: The fixed-term account pays higher interest.
This loan is less expensive.
That option is the best for short-term saving.

pronunciation.focus: Đọc phần trăm và số thập phân
pronunciation.tip: 5.5% = five point five percent. 0.25 = zero point two five. Nhấn PER-cent.

speakingTasks: Tư vấn cho thầy/cô chọn giữa hai gói tiết kiệm, giải thích bằng so sánh.
Thầy/cô hỏi về khoản vay mua xe — trả lời cơ bản.

questions.prompt: How long does the customer want to save?
questions.explanation: 'for two years'.

questions.prompt: What rate does the fixed-term deposit pay?
questions.explanation: 'pays 5.5% a year'.

questions.prompt: What is the advantage of the flexible account?
questions.explanation: 'you can take your money out at any time'.

questions.prompt: What happens if the customer withdraws early?
questions.explanation: 'You'll lose some of the interest.'
Dấu thập phân đọc 'point'.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: A _____ account lets you withdraw anytime.
questions.explanation: “flexible” nghĩa là “linh hoạt”. Câu đầy đủ: A flexible account lets you withdraw anytime.
“fixed-term deposit” = tiền gửi có kỳ hạn. Ví dụ: I have a fixed-term deposit.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: If you _____, you lose interest.
questions.explanation: “withdraw early” nghĩa là “rút trước hạn”. Câu đầy đủ: If you withdraw early, you lose interest.
“loan” = khoản vay. Ví dụ: I'd like to apply for a loan.
“interest rate” nghĩa là “lãi suất”. Câu đầy đủ: What's the interest rate?

lessons.title: Chi phí và ngân sách cá nhân
lessons.objective: Nói về thu nhập, chi tiêu, tiết kiệm và lập ngân sách tháng.
lessons.reading: I earn about fifteen million dong a month. I spend five million on rent and three million on food. Transport costs about one million. I try to save four million every month. I don't spend much on clothes, but I sometimes spend too much on eating out. My goal is to save enough money for a motorbike by the end of the year.

vocabulary.example: I earn fifteen million a month.
I spend five million on rent.
I save four million every month.
I make a budget every month.

grammar.title: too much / too many / enough
grammar.explanation: too much + không đếm được (too much money), too many + đếm được (too many coffees). enough + danh từ (enough money) / tính từ + enough (old enough).
examples: I spend too much money on food.
I buy too many clothes.
I don't have enough savings yet.

pronunciation.tip: Quá khứ spent có âm /t/ cuối rõ: I spent a lot last month.

speakingTasks: Mô tả ngân sách tháng của bạn: thu, chi, tiết kiệm.
Thầy/cô cho lời khuyên — bạn phản hồi.

questions.prompt: How much does the writer earn?
questions.explanation: 'about fifteen million dong a month'.
Rent 5 triệu là lớn nhất.

questions.prompt: How much does the writer save monthly?
questions.explanation: 'save four million every month'.

questions.prompt: What does the writer spend too much on?
questions.explanation: 'too much on eating out'.
money không đếm được → too much.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Transport _____s one million.
questions.explanation: “cost” nghĩa là “có giá, tốn”. Câu đầy đủ: Transport costs one million.
“earn” = kiếm (thu nhập). Ví dụ: I earn fifteen million a month.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: I _____ four million every month.
questions.explanation: “save” nghĩa là “tiết kiệm”. Câu đầy đủ: I save four million every month.
“cost” = có giá, tốn. Ví dụ: Transport costs one million.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: My _____ is quite high.
questions.explanation: “rent” nghĩa là “tiền thuê nhà”. Câu đầy đủ: My rent is quite high.

lessons.title: Email nhắc nợ lịch sự
lessons.objective: Viết và nói lời nhắc thanh toán quá hạn một cách lịch sự, chuyên nghiệp.
lessons.reading:
Subject: Payment reminder – Invoice 1024
Dear Mr. Hung,
I hope you are well. This is a friendly reminder that invoice 1024 for $640 was due on 30 April. According to our records, we have not received payment yet. If you have already paid, please ignore this email. Otherwise, could you arrange payment by 10 May?
Kind regards,
Lan, Accounts Department

vocabulary.definition: theo hồ sơ của chúng tôi
vocabulary.example: According to our records, it is unpaid.
Please ignore this email if you have paid.

grammar.title: Hiện tại hoàn thành với yet / already trong email
grammar.explanation: We have not received payment yet. If you have already paid, … Dùng để nói trạng thái hiện tại của một việc.
examples: We haven't received your reply yet.
I have already sent the invoice.
Have you paid the bill yet?

pronunciation.tip: Nhấn 'FRIENDly REminder' với giọng nhẹ. 'received' /rɪˈsiːvd/ — đuôi -ed /d/.

speakingTasks: Gọi điện nhắc khách hàng (thầy/cô) thanh toán quá hạn một cách lịch sự.
Khách hàng xin gia hạn — bạn thương lượng ngày mới.

questions.explanation: 'invoice 1024'.
'was due on 30 April'.
'arrange payment by 10 May'.

questions.prompt: What should the customer do if they have paid?
questions.explanation: 'please ignore this email'.
have not + V3 + yet.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: We have not _____d payment.
questions.explanation: “receive” nghĩa là “nhận được”. Câu đầy đủ: We have not received payment.
“ignore” = bỏ qua. Ví dụ: Please ignore this email if you have paid.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: This is a friendly _____.
questions.explanation: “reminder” nghĩa là “lời nhắc”. Câu đầy đủ: This is a friendly reminder.
“reminder” = lời nhắc. Ví dụ: This is a friendly reminder.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Could you _____ soon?
questions.explanation: “arrange payment” nghĩa là “sắp xếp thanh toán”. Câu đầy đủ: Could you arrange payment soon?

lessons.title: Mô tả báo cáo tài chính
lessons.objective: Đọc và giải thích các chỉ số chính: doanh thu, chi phí, lợi nhuận, biên lợi nhuận.
lessons.reading: In the third quarter, revenue increased by 12% to $4.5 million, driven mainly by strong online sales. However, operating costs rose faster, by 18%, due to higher shipping prices. As a result, net profit fell slightly to $420,000, and our profit margin decreased from 11% to 9.3%. We expect margins to recover in the fourth quarter as new shipping contracts take effect.

vocabulary.example: Growth was driven by online sales.
The new contracts take effect next month.

grammar.title: Giới từ với số liệu: by / to / from … to
grammar.explanation: increase BY 12% (mức thay đổi), increase TO $4.5m (giá trị mới), decrease FROM 11% TO 9.3%. due to + danh từ = do, bởi vì.
examples: Sales rose by 5% to $2 million.
Costs fell from $800,000 to $750,000.
Profit dropped due to higher taxes.

pronunciation.tip: four point five million dollars; four hundred and twenty thousand dollars. Nhấn số, nói rõ 'million'.

speakingTasks: Giải thích một báo cáo quý (tưởng tượng) cho sếp bằng 4–5 câu.
Thầy/cô hỏi 'Why did costs rise?' — giải thích nguyên nhân.

questions.prompt: By how much did revenue increase?
questions.explanation: 'revenue increased by 12%'.
'due to higher shipping prices'.
'net profit fell slightly'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct preposition: The margin fell ___ 11% ___ 9.3%.
questions.explanation: from (giá trị cũ) to (giá trị mới).

questions.prompt: Why do they expect margins to recover?
questions.explanation: 'as new shipping contracts take effect'.
“operating costs” nghĩa là “chi phí hoạt động”. Câu đầy đủ: Operating costs rose by 18%.
“take effect” = có hiệu lực. Ví dụ: The new contracts take effect next month.
“revenue” nghĩa là “doanh thu”. Câu đầy đủ: Revenue increased by 12%.
“net profit” = lợi nhuận ròng. Ví dụ: Net profit fell slightly.
“profit margin” nghĩa là “biên lợi nhuận”. Câu đầy đủ: Our profit margin decreased.

lessons.title: Tư vấn đầu tư cơ bản
lessons.objective: Giải thích rủi ro – lợi nhuận, đa dạng hóa và khẩu vị rủi ro của khách hàng.
lessons.reading:
Advisor: Before we choose any investments, I need to understand your goals. How long are you planning to invest for?
Client: About ten years, for my children's education.
Advisor: And how would you feel if your investment lost 20% in one year?
Client: Quite nervous, to be honest.
Advisor: Then a balanced portfolio would suit you — a mix of bonds, which are lower risk, and shares, which offer higher potential returns. Diversification reduces the impact if one market performs badly.

vocabulary.example: I plan to invest for ten years.

grammar.title: Mệnh đề quan hệ which/who để giải thích
grammar.explanation: Dùng which (vật) / who (người) để giải thích thuật ngữ ngay trong câu: bonds, which are lower risk, … Câu điều kiện loại 2 để hỏi giả định: How would you feel if…?
examples: Shares, which can be volatile, suit long-term investors.
A client who needs money soon should avoid risk.
What would you do if the market fell?

pronunciation.tip: portfolio /pɔːtˈfəʊliəʊ/, diversification /daɪˌvɜːsɪfɪˈkeɪʃən/ — đuôi -tion nhấn âm ngay trước.

speakingTasks: Tư vấn đầu tư cho thầy/cô: hỏi mục tiêu, thời gian, khẩu vị rủi ro.
Giải thích 'diversification' cho người không chuyên.

questions.prompt: How long does the client plan to invest?
questions.explanation: 'About ten years'.
'for my children's education'.

questions.prompt: How would the client feel about a 20% loss?
questions.explanation: 'Quite nervous'.

questions.prompt: Which portfolio does the advisor suggest?
questions.explanation: 'a balanced portfolio would suit you'.

options: To reduce the impact of one bad market
questions.explanation: 'reduces the impact if one market performs badly'.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: What's the expected _____?
questions.explanation: “return” nghĩa là “lợi nhuận (đầu tư)”. Câu đầy đủ: What's the expected return?
“shares” = cổ phiếu. Ví dụ: Shares can offer higher returns.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: _____ can offer higher returns.
questions.explanation: “shares” nghĩa là “cổ phiếu”. Câu đầy đủ: Shares can offer higher returns.
“invest” = đầu tư. Ví dụ: I plan to invest for ten years.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: _____s are lower risk.
questions.explanation: “bond” nghĩa là “trái phiếu”. Câu đầy đủ: Bonds are lower risk.

lessons.title: Kiểm soát chi phí doanh nghiệp
lessons.objective: Đề xuất cắt giảm chi phí và đánh giá tác động.
lessons.reading: Our travel expenses have doubled this year. I suggest that we replace most face-to-face meetings with video calls. We could also negotiate better rates with our hotel partners. If we cut travel by 40%, we would save around $60,000 annually. However, we need to make sure that important client relationships aren't affected.

grammar.title: Câu điều kiện loại 2 cho giả định ngân sách
grammar.explanation: If + quá khứ đơn, would + V: tính toán giả định. If we cut travel by 40%, we would save… affect (động từ) ≠ effect (danh từ).
examples: If we reduced staff, morale would fall.
If we switched suppliers, we'd save 10%.
The change had a big effect on costs.

pronunciation.tip: Phát âm gần giống; phân biệt bằng loại từ: affect là động từ, effect là danh từ.

speakingTasks: Đề xuất 3 cách cắt giảm chi phí cho công ty và nêu tác động.
Thầy/cô phản đối một đề xuất — bạn bảo vệ bằng số liệu.

questions.explanation: 'Our travel expenses have doubled'.

options: Video calls instead of most meetings
questions.explanation: 'replace most face-to-face meetings with video calls'.
'around $60,000 annually'.
'important client relationships aren't affected'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: The new policy had a positive ___ on costs.
questions.explanation: Danh từ: effect.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: This won't _____ our clients.
questions.explanation: “affect” nghĩa là “ảnh hưởng (động từ)”. Câu đầy đủ: This won't affect our clients.
“annually” = hàng năm. Ví dụ: We would save $60,000 annually.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Let's _____ better rates.
questions.explanation: “negotiate” nghĩa là “đàm phán”. Câu đầy đủ: Let's negotiate better rates.
“double” = tăng gấp đôi. Ví dụ: Prices doubled in two years.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: We prefer _____ meetings.
questions.explanation: “face-to-face” nghĩa là “trực tiếp”. Câu đầy đủ: We prefer face-to-face meetings.

lessons.title: Thuyết trình kết quả kinh doanh cho nhà đầu tư
lessons.objective: Trình bày kết quả, giải thích biến động và đưa dự báo một cách thuyết phục.
lessons.reading: Despite a challenging macroeconomic environment, we delivered revenue growth of 8% year on year. This was largely attributable to our expansion into Southeast Asia, which now accounts for a quarter of total sales. Gross margin was squeezed by rising input costs; nevertheless, disciplined cost control enabled us to maintain EBITDA broadly in line with expectations. Looking ahead, we anticipate double-digit growth, assuming currency volatility remains manageable.

vocabulary.definition: so với cùng kỳ năm trước

vocabulary.example: Growth was attributable to new markets.
Results were in line with expectations.

grammar.title: Ngôn ngữ thận trọng (hedging)
grammar.explanation: Dùng largely, broadly, approximately, we anticipate, assuming that… để tránh cam kết tuyệt đối. Nhượng bộ: Despite + N, nevertheless.
examples: Growth was largely driven by exports.
We anticipate modest improvement, assuming demand holds.
Despite the downturn, margins were broadly stable.

pronunciation.tip: EBITDA đọc /ˈiːbɪtdɑː/ hoặc /iːˈbɪtdɑː/. YoY đọc 'year on year'. Đọc tự tin, không đánh vần.

speakingTasks: Thuyết trình 1 phút về kết quả kinh doanh (tưởng tượng) cho nhà đầu tư.
Thầy/cô là nhà đầu tư — hỏi về rủi ro tỷ giá.

questions.explanation: 'revenue growth of 8% year on year'.

questions.prompt: What was growth mainly due to?
questions.explanation: 'attributable to our expansion into Southeast Asia'.

questions.prompt: What share of sales does Southeast Asia represent?
questions.explanation: 'accounts for a quarter of total sales'.
'squeezed by rising input costs'.

questions.prompt: Which word is an example of hedging?
questions.explanation: largely = phần lớn (thận trọng).

lessons.title: Đàm phán điều khoản tín dụng
lessons.objective: Đàm phán lãi suất, tài sản bảo đảm và điều khoản vay với ngân hàng.
lessons.reading:
CFO: We're looking for a five-year loan of two million dollars to fund our new factory.
Banker: Based on your financials, we could offer 7.2%, secured against the property.
CFO: Given our strong cash flow and clean credit history, we were hoping for something closer to 6.5%.
Banker: We might be able to go to 6.8% if you agree to maintain a debt-to-equity ratio below 1.5.
CFO: That's acceptable, provided there's no penalty for early repayment.
Banker: I'll need to check with our credit committee, but that should be possible.

vocabulary.example: The loan will fund the new factory.
The loan is secured against the property.
They have a clean credit history.

vocabulary.definition: tỷ lệ nợ trên vốn chủ sở hữu

vocabulary.example: Is there a penalty for early repayment?

grammar.title: Nhượng bộ có điều kiện: if / provided / we were hoping for
grammar.explanation: Quá khứ tiếp diễn 'we were hoping for…' làm yêu cầu mềm hơn. might be able to + V cho nhượng bộ chưa chắc chắn. provided (that) đặt điều kiện.
examples: We were hoping for a lower rate.
We might be able to extend the term.
We'll accept, provided the fees are waived.

pronunciation.focus: Đọc tỷ lệ và lãi suất
pronunciation.tip: 7.2% seven point two percent; ratio 1.5 'one point five'. Nhấn con số đề xuất khi đàm phán.

speakingTasks: Đàm phán khoản vay với thầy/cô (ngân hàng): lãi suất, kỳ hạn, điều kiện.
Đưa một nhượng bộ và đặt một điều kiện.

questions.explanation: 'to fund our new factory'.

lessons.title: Rủi ro, tuân thủ và chống rửa tiền
lessons.objective: Thảo luận rủi ro tài chính, tuân thủ quy định và quy trình KYC/AML.
lessons.reading: Financial institutions are required to verify the identity of their customers before opening accounts — a process known as Know Your Customer (KYC). Transactions that appear unusual, such as large cash deposits inconsistent with a customer's profile, must be flagged and reported to the authorities. Failure to comply with anti-money laundering (AML) regulations can result in heavy fines and serious reputational damage.

vocabulary.example: Money laundering is a serious crime.

grammar.title: Cấu trúc bị động với động từ tường thuật: be required to / be known as
grammar.explanation: be required to + V (bị yêu cầu phải), known as (được gọi là), result in + N (dẫn đến). Câu bị động giúp văn bản quy định khách quan.
examples: Staff are required to complete AML training.
This process is known as due diligence.
Breaches can result in heavy fines.

speakingTasks: Giải thích cho khách hàng (thầy/cô) vì sao ngân hàng cần xác minh giấy tờ.
Thảo luận một giao dịch đáng ngờ và cách xử lý.

questions.explanation: 'verify the identity of their customers… Know Your Customer'.

options: Large cash deposits inconsistent with the profile
questions.explanation: 'large cash deposits inconsistent with a customer's profile'.

questions.prompt: What can failure to comply result in?
questions.explanation: 'heavy fines and serious reputational damage'.

options: Staff are required to complete training.
questions.explanation: be required to + V.
result in = dẫn đến.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Unusual transactions are _____ged.
questions.explanation: “flag” nghĩa là “đánh dấu cảnh báo”. Câu đầy đủ: Unusual transactions are flagged.
“identity” = danh tính. Ví dụ: Please prove your identity.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: _____ is a serious crime.
questions.explanation: “money laundering” nghĩa là “rửa tiền”. Câu đầy đủ: Money laundering is a serious crime.
“verify” = xác minh. Ví dụ: We must verify your identity.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence: Banks must _____ regulations.
questions.explanation: “comply with” nghĩa là “tuân thủ”. Câu đầy đủ: Banks must comply with regulations.
